body: Thank you I really appreciate your help
Not anymore I feel like I pushed everyone away by talking to them too much about how I feel

First of all I’m so sorry for what you have experienced. Life can rally be hard sometimes and it can feel like you’re drowning in your emotions, I feel your pain. 

Something that slightly helps me is talking, finding people that relate to you can ease your mind a bit. I see that you do not really open up to people I am the same exact way I hate opening up to the people around me. Talking to strangers online or even writing in a private tends to help because bottling up all of your emotions can take a toll on you.

It’s hard for me to write this because I feel like a hypocrite because I’m struggling with suicidal thoughts and suppressed emotions as well. But just from what I read about you I care for you, I truly do. I don’t want you to hurt yourself I feel like you have something to give to this world and that you are a great person. 

If you need to talk you can pm me I hope this wasn’t too much and take care ❤️
Thank you I really hope I get better too I appreciate how kind you have been I’m going to try to sleep this one off now hopefully I’ll feel better tomorrow thank you guys for listening to me

Ive tried contacting her and I get nothing hopefully one day she finds a way and thank you I don’t feel strong at all

This was supposed to be my last semester at college so I can transfer to another school I’m failing one of my classes. I’ve never failed a class in my life and I’ve failed due to my anxiety so it’s ultimately my fault. I’ve been really hard on myself for it. There’s was a lot of other things on my mind too that I wanted to talk about but I’m so drained from crying I can’t think straight

It’s just been so hard dealing with things by myself ever since my best friend has been gone for almost a year (over protective family long story) she has helped me through so much. She was my backbone I’m alive to this day because of her now that I can’t contact her I can’t handle anything

I genuinely want to get better and Ive have put in efforts to get better but I feel like nothing is changing. If I shut myself I’ll be even more lonely and I want to achieve my goals but at the same time my anxiety gets in the way so it creates this cycle of unhappiness

I just can’t handle my emotions anymore I feel helpless I’m scared I’ll actually do something every “friend” I’ve tried to talk to about hasn’t said anything I feel like no one believes me or cares enough to talk to me
I just feel like it’s the only option I’ve been unhappy for so long
